name: vllm_batched_moe_align_block_size
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench test_batched_moe_align_block_size.py. MoE token alignment: given expert_num_tokens, computes sorted token IDs, expert IDs, and padded count. Inputs: max_tokens/block_size (scalars), expert_num_tokens (randint int32), preallocated buffers. Reference mutates buffers in-place and returns tuple (sorted_ids, expert_ids, num_tokens_post_pad). Shapes: sorted_ids/expert_ids sized from scalar params; gen_inputs handles bounded randint + buffer sizing. Requires vLLM at eval time.
